_what_this_is: Producer cost receipts reconciled against engine cost events on the artifact digest, per TRACKA-RECON-2. The live ledger was read read-only. A control runs first so an empty result cannot be confused with a broken join.
what_this_result_means: NO PRODUCER ENTRY CARRIES refs.artifact_digest. costs.to_engine_entries puts provenance in refs but not the digest, so the producer side has nothing to join ON. This is the single blocking gap, and it is Archaeon's to close: set refs.artifact_digest to the same string the event declares in source_refs/output_refs.

The producer's declared references are experiment UUIDs, not content digests (01dab91c-e09f-474c-b...). Even with refs populated, those identify a ROW rather than the BYTES, so the two sides would be naming different kinds of thing. A digest join needs both sides to agree on which identity they are joining on.
